acceptance_predicates.description: A clean room completes default-dev install, wizard selection, benchmark, recording, offline replay, comparison, rollback, and removal.
Provider, authentication method, agents, models, workloads, and shared defaults are selection-driven and recorded.
Replay denies network access and consumes only the recorded cassette.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management are visible warnings and never blockers.

definition_of_done: Exact paired heads pass the full journey with human and JSON receipts.
Independent review accepts cleanup and network-denial evidence.

inputs.description: Exact ASB/TUI heads and disposable workspace.
